name: TC-SL-003 — 店铺列表筛选功能 [P0]
description: 验证店铺列表5项筛选条件：店铺名称模糊搜索、Seller ID搜索、买手筛选、产运筛选、视觉状态筛选

steps.expression: (() => { const totalRows = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row, tbody tr').length; return { totalRows }; })()

(() => { const statusSelect = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-select')).find(s => s.textContent.includes('视觉状态') || s.closest('[class*=filter]')?.textContent.includes('视觉状态')); if (statusSelect) { statusSelect.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()
steps.description: 打开视觉状态筛选下拉

steps.expression: (() => { const options = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-item-option, .ant-select-dropdown li')).map(o => o.textContent.trim()); return { options }; })()

(() => { const expected = ['视觉未启动', '视觉定制中（冷启）', '视觉定制中（新增）', '正常运行']; const options = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-item-option, .ant-select-dropdown li')).map(o => o.textContent.trim()); const matched = expected.filter(e => options.some(o => o.includes(e))); return { expected, matched, allMatched: matched.length === expected.length }; })()
steps.description: 验证4种视觉状态选项完整

_testDesign.preconditions: 店铺列表存在不同视觉状态的店铺
_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 记录筛选前总行数
2. 打开视觉状态筛选
3. 检查4种视觉状态选项
4. 选择某状态后验证列表过滤
_testDesign.expectedResult:
1. 筛选区展示5个筛选项
2. 视觉状态下拉包含4种状态：视觉未启动、视觉定制中（冷启）、视觉定制中（新增）、正常运行
3. 选择筛选后列表正确过滤
_testDesign.groupPath: 风格店铺协作平台/店铺列表
